<thought>Applying retrosynthetic template 733 to the sulfonamide “O= Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Nc2ccc(C)cc2)cc1” breaks the S–N bond, yielding a sulfonyl chloride fragment attached to the aldehyde‑bearing aromatic ring and an aniline fragment bearing the methyl substituent. The two precursor SMILES are therefore:
- Sulfonyl chloride: ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C=O)cc1
- Aniline: Nc1ccc(C)cc1

These are the only products generated by this template.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C=O)cc1\", \"Nc1ccc(C)cc1\"]]</final_answer>
